data.title: 中野五月 · 梳妆镜前取下星形发夹
data.description: 夜深人静的卧室梳妆台前，柔和的暖黄台灯驱散了夜色。五月身着素雅纯白的荷叶边长睡裙，抬起白皙纤细的手臂，小心翼翼地取下别在鬓发两侧的五角星发夹。丰盈如瀑的赤红长发彻底倾泻散落，镜中映出她卸下所有伪装与防备后那双深情而温柔的眼眸。
data.action: taking off star hairpins, arms raised, hair cascading down, tender gaze in mirror
data.lighting: warm golden vanity lamp and soft mirror reflections
data.promptProse: Sitting before her wooden vanity mirror at night, Nakano Itsuki removes her signature star hairpins wearing an elegant ruffled white cotton nightgown. Her luxuriant wavy red hair cascades freely over her bare collarbones as she looks warmly into the mirror reflection.
data.animaCaption: Itsuki letting down her red hair at her vanity mirror at night.
